# P.S. Coffee

> P.S. Coffee is a grab-and-go specialty coffee brand building compact Pods in and around the offices, co-working spaces, campuses and gyms where people spend their day. Ahmedabad first.

P.S. Coffee is pre-launch. No Pod is open yet. Opening news goes to the waitlist at https://www.pscoffee.in/pods#waitlist.

## The Pod
A P.S. Pod is P.S. Coffee's compact grab-and-go format: 50 to 200 sq ft, specialty coffee ground at every order, placed inside a building or on the corner outside it. It is not a cafe, and it is not a kiosk. There is no seating.

## The menu
- The Letter: four drinks that never change. P.S. Black, P.S. White, P.S. Green (ceremonial-grade matcha) and P.S. Strong (protein coffee).
- The P.S.: three or four rotating versions behind them, numbered rather than named.
- Quality: specialty grade, every lot. Ground at every order.
- Planned menu: https://www.pscoffee.in/menu

## Where
Ahmedabad first. Areas being explored, none confirmed: Prahlad Nagar, SG Highway, Makarba and SBR in Ahmedabad; GIFT City and the TCS area in Gandhinagar.
